exposure: Women who breastfed exclusively for ≥ 1 month
No breastfeeding or formula supplementation < 1 month postpartum
Women who did not breastfeed or added formula < 1 month postpartum
cohort: 229 women with a prior diagnosis of GDM from a single teaching hospital between 2009 and 2016
finding: The study found that exclusive lactation for at least one month was associated with a reduced recurrence rate of GDM and a lower risk of cesarean delivery in a subsequent pregnancy.
mod_finding: Exclusive breastfeeding for at least one month was linked to a reduced recurrence rate of gestational diabetes and potentially a lower risk of cesarean delivery in subsequent pregnancies.
